checks.reason: PROD-MIX-01 operational rehearsal (live AWS sandbox, operator runbook MIXED-PARTITIONS.md and MIXED-RECOVERY.md sections 1 and 4) passed: a plan whose child on the -live2 connection consumed a typed output of a child on the -live connection, with no declared connectivity, was refused (plan_refused); an independent plan put one child on each connection in two partitions, both succeeded with receipts linking their child operations, and by independent readback each environment holds exactly one tagged bucket of its own and each child's OpenTofu state is in its own connection's state bucket only; the -live2 connection was then revoked through connection.revoke (status revoked) and a new plan on it was refused (connection_unverified). Approvals by an automated test approver through the browser path

PROD-MIX-02 operational rehearsal (live AWS sandbox, operator runbook MIXED-PARTITIONS.md and MIXED-RECOVERY.md sections 1 and 4) passed: the execution worker was stopped while the producer's OpenTofu apply ran (deployment step apply_infrastructure) and restarted 219 s later; the producer ended succeeded with exactly one tagged bucket in AWS; the stored parent plan's digests, dependency order and all 2 stable resource addresses were identical after the proposal, at the stop and at the end; the producer had no receipt at the stop, and both receipts link their child operations and re-derive from their own fields. Approvals by an automated test approver through the browser path

PROD-MIX-03 operational rehearsal (live AWS sandbox, operator runbook MIXED-PARTITIONS.md and MIXED-RECOVERY.md sections 1 and 4) passed: the producer's newly materialized output changed the consumer's effect, so the consumer waited for a review binding the new parent digest (previous e2198a865a8f, required abb42c9b2215); after a person approved it the consumer ran with the typed output, and by independent readback its deployed PRODUCER_BUCKET_ARN equals the producer bucket ARN, the only tagged bucket of the parent (provenance). Approvals by an automated test approver through the browser path

PROD-MIX-04 operational rehearsal (live AWS sandbox, operator runbook MIXED-PARTITIONS.md and MIXED-RECOVERY.md sections 1 and 4) passed: with the producer succeeded and the consumer waiting for its output review, the operator cancelled the run (POST /api/platform/v1/operations/:id/mixed-run/cancel); the run reads partial and cancelled, with the producer in appliedWithoutRunCompletion, the consumer cancelled before it started, atomicity none, automatic compensation never and propose_teardown_for_human_approval among the next steps (propose_teardown_for_human_approval, review_replan), and AWS still holds the producer bucket and nothing of the consumer (nothing compensated); the product tore down all 3 parents, newest first: each run's teardown proposal (consumers first); each step's destroy opened in the child's own environment once its deploy activity settled (86 minutes after the last deploy), released, approved by a person and synced destroyed, one at a time (5 steps); releasing a producer before its consumer was refused (ordering_blocked); afterwards AWS shows no tagged bucket or function in any of the run's 6 environments. Approvals by an automated test approver through the browser path
